jobs.title: Head of Internal Communications
jobs.description: Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide. Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026 ! We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm. About the Role We’re looking for a Head of Internal Communications to shape how Phantom communicates, aligns, and rallies our people around where we’re going, how we’re going to win, and why their work matters. Working directly with our three co-founders and executive team, you’ll serve as a strategic advisor on company-critical communications, translating complex strategies and decisions into compelling narratives that build clarity and conviction. Beyond executive messaging, you’ll build the systems that bring those messages to life across the organization, equipping managers to engage their teams, strengthening two-way communication, and ensuring our most important messages truly resonate. This is a highly strategic, hands-on opportunity for an exceptional storyteller with strong business instincts, the confidence to challenge senior leaders, and the drive to build a high-impact function from the ground up. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies.
